sections.title: The best, the cheapest, the biggest
sections.content: You already know how to make a comparative with -bb: jobb ("better"), olcsóbb ("cheaper"), nagyobb ("bigger"). To make a superlative — "the best", "the cheapest", "the biggest" — just add leg- to the front of the comparative. leg- never changes shape, no matter what the word is: legjobb, legolcsóbb, legnagyobb.

items.spanish: Ez a legjobb szoba a szállodában.
items.english: This is the best room in the hotel.

sections.content: Build the superlative in two steps in your head: first the comparative (olcsó → olcsóbb), then leg- glued straight onto the front (legolcsóbb). If you can already make the comparative, the superlative costs you nothing extra.
